(montelukast) Adverse Effects and Precautions As for Zafirlukast, p.1150. ◊ Suspected adverse effects reported to the UK CSM after the launch of montelukast included oedema, agitation and restless- ness, allergy (including anaphylaxis, angioedema, and urticaria), chest pain, tremor, dry mouth, vertigo, and arthralgia.1 Further suspected adverse effects included nightmares, sedation, palpita- tions, and increased sweating.2 In March 2008 the FDA announced3 that it was investigating a possible association be- tween the use of montelukast and behaviour/mood changes, sui- cidality, and suicide. Other postmarketing adverse events that had been incorporated into the US licensed product information in the previous year had included: tremor, depression, suicidality, and anxiousness. 1.
